description: KuCoin's public API for spot pairs: daily (or 1h/4h) candles back to the year you pick, then kept current every 6 hours. No keys. Each closed month and day is paged from the API and written once as a gzipped CSV, with what it covered in a manifest. Files go to the lake under raw/kucoin/spot/<instance>. The spot leg for a spot-versus-perpetual (carry) study on KuCoin.

symbols.title: Pairs
symbols.description: USDT or USDC pairs without the dash, e.g. BTCUSDT (sent to KuCoin as BTC-USDT).

start_year.title: From the start of
start_year.description: KuCoin's BTC-USDT daily candles start in October 2017; months before a pair listed are skipped.
